workload.content: Five partially transparent painted raster layers in one isolated group followed by a Brightness/Contrast adjustment.

constrained_capacity.status: Unsupported: resource capacity; CPU recovery matched the reference

verification.note: The Video render/export gate initially failed when replacing an output file and passed on an isolated rerun with no code changes. Record the intermittent failure; investigate if it recurs. The earlier neutral-adjustment rounding regression was corrected and its core/native gates passed.

limits: Single local profile after scoped builds/tests; timings and sampled memory are observations, not latency or memory guarantees.
Cold means the first 1080p preparation/composition with empty application content caches; the GPU correctness scenes warmed the context/program and driver caches were not cleared.
GPU totals include synchronous readback for measurement; production preview delivers texture leases directly and the adjustment itself performs no GPU-to-CPU readback.

Sampled process peaks include Qt/driver/session state and correctness scenes; the GPU process includes a separate constrained-capacity context and CPU recovery. These are not whole-application or VRAM peaks.
The base update appends a 30 px painted point. Parameter changes assert no source reconstruction/uploads; timings are measured separately for brightness and contrast.
Production limits remain 64 MiB CPU raster cache and 256 MiB GPU textures; the 64 MiB GPU scenario is an artificial capacity-recovery test.
Native visual acceptance and macOS/Linux builds and native runtime/driver validation remain pending.
